description: This file manages delegation credentials, including fetching, building, and enriching user and host credentials with delegation data, supporting multiple calendar and conferencing platforms.

classes.name: DelegationCredential
classes.description: Represents a delegation credential with an ID, workspace platform slug, and optional service account key.

classes.name: DelegationCredentialWithSensitiveServiceAccountKey
classes.description: Extends DelegationCredential to include a non-null service account key.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user with email and ID.

classes.name: Host
classes.description: Generic host type containing a user with credentials.

methods.name: isValidWorkspaceSlug
methods.description: Checks if a given workspace slug is valid.

methods.name: getDelegationCredentialAppMetadata
methods.description: Returns app metadata based on workspace slug and conferencing status.

methods.name: _isConferencingCredential
methods.description: Determines if a credential is a conferencing type based on its type string.

methods.name: _buildCommonUserCredential
methods.description: Builds a common user credential object from delegation credential and user info.

methods.name: _buildDelegatedCalendarCredential
methods.description: Builds a calendar credential for a user based on delegation credential.

methods.name: _buildDelegatedCalendarCredentialWithServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Builds a calendar credential including service account key.

methods.name: _buildDelegatedConferencingCredential
methods.description: Builds a conferencing credential for a user based on delegation credential.

methods.name: getAllDelegationCredentialsForUserIncludeServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Fetches all delegation credentials for a user, including sensitive service account keys.

methods.name: getAllDelegationCredentialsForUser
methods.description: Fetches all delegation credentials for a user, excluding sensitive keys.

methods.name: getAllDelegatedCalendarCredentialsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all delegated calendar credentials for a user.

methods.name: _getDelegationCredentialsMapPerUser
methods.description: Creates a map of user IDs to their delegation credentials within an organization.

methods.name: assertSuccessfullyConfiguredInWorkspace
methods.description: Verifies that delegation credentials are correctly configured in the workspace.

methods.name: getAllDelegationCredentialsForUserByAppType
methods.description: Filters user's delegation credentials by app type.

methods.name: getAllDelegationCredentialsForUserByAppSlug
methods.description: Filters user's delegation credentials by app slug.

methods.name: buildAllCredentials
methods.description: Combines delegation credentials and existing credentials, removing duplicates.

methods.name: enrichUsersWithDelegationCredentials
methods.description: Enriches a list of users with their delegation credentials.

methods.name: enrichHostsWithDelegationCredentials
methods.description: Enriches hosts with their delegation credentials.

methods.name: enrichUserWithDelegationCredentialsIncludeServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Enriches a user with delegation credentials including sensitive service account keys.

methods.name: enrichUserWithDelegationCredentials
methods.description: Enriches a user with delegation credentials, filtering for conferencing credentials.

methods.name: enrichUserWithDelegationConferencingCredentialsWithoutOrgId
methods.description: Enriches a user with only conferencing credentials, without organization context.

methods.name: getDelegationCredentialOrFindRegularCredential
methods.description: Retrieves a delegation credential or finds a regular credential if not delegated.

methods.name: getDelegationCredentialOrRegularCredential
methods.description: Finds a credential from a list, supporting both delegated and regular credentials.

methods.name: getFirstDelegationConferencingCredential
methods.description: Finds the first conferencing credential in a list.

methods.name: getFirstDelegationConferencingCredentialAppLocation
methods.description: Gets the location type of the first conferencing credential.

methods.name: findUniqueDelegationCalendarCredential
methods.description: Finds a unique delegation calendar credential for a user.

methods.name: getUsersCredentialsIncludeServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials for a user, including delegated service account keys.

methods.name: getUsersCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials for a user, excluding delegated keys.

methods.name: getCredentialForSelectedCalendar
methods.description: Gets the credential for a specific selected calendar, supporting delegation.
